response.text: Buy Vendor B — although its first-year total (14k + 3k + 1.5k = $18.5k) is $500 more than Vendor A’s $18k, B’s ongoing cost is $17k/year versus A’s $18k, so you recover the one‑time $1.5k onboarding after about 1.5 years (18 months) and save roughly $1k each year after that; if you plan to keep the service longer than ~18 months choose B for lower lifetime cost, otherwise choose A for the slightly cheaper first year.
